definitions.timestamps: …Utc columns are ISO-8601 UTC; …NewYork columns are New York wall-clock time (America/New_York, labelled ET). Minute bars are labelled by their start: an entry or exit time is the start of the minute bar that filled (the session close time for a closing print), and an MAE/MFE time is the start of the marked bar (the session close for a close mark)
definitions.status: closed = exited (realized); open = still held at the run end, marked at the last session close (unrealized)
definitions.entrySetup: the D1 setup that armed the entry: 'deep' = the X% decline from the rolling L-session high; 'continuation' = the post-exit continuation pullback
definitions.decision: the end of the completed minute whose close confirmed the rebound from the trailing low (bar start + 1 minute); the order fills at the first bar starting at or after it, so decision and entry often show the same clock minute
definitions.entryFillReason: the engine's entry execution: 'first trade after decision' (the next minute's open), 'opening trade' (next session's open) or 'closing print'
definitions.exitReason: the engine's exit rule: trailing stop, trailing stop gap, maximum hold, buffered intraday loss
definitions.exitFillReason: the engine's exit execution: 'stop level', 'minute open through stop', 'trigger minute close', 'opening trade', 'first trade after decision' or 'closing print'
definitions.prices: fill prices are the raw execution prices; …AfterFriction includes the per-side cost (and stop slippage, 0 bps here). Prices and shares are in the run's first-session share units (splits forward-adjusted); dollar amounts are unaffected
definitions.grossPnl: shares × (exit fill − entry fill) before costs; an open lot uses the as-of mark price
definitions.friction: entryFriction = shares × (entry price after friction − entry fill); exitFriction = shares × (exit fill − exit price after friction), 0 for an open lot (not yet charged)
definitions.marginInterest: principal × 11% × interestDays ÷ 365 (simple); paid at exit for a closed lot, accrued to the as-of session for an open lot
definitions.net: the engine's net = gross − friction − interest; realizedNet for closed lots, unrealizedNet for open lots; cumulativeNet in entry order
definitions.mae: the engine's maximum adverse excursion: the most negative mark while held (shares × last price − principal − accrued interest), floored at $0; percent of the $100,000 principal
definitions.mfe: the maximum favourable excursion: the most positive mark at the same marks, floored at $0. Replayed (see mfeStatus) because the engine does not record it
definitions.sessionsHeld: sessions from the entry session to the exit (or last) session, inclusive
definitions.calendarDaysHeld: exit time (or the last session close for an open lot) − entry time, in days
definitions.sameMinuteCandidates: books signalling in the funding decision minute (ties go alphabetically)
definitions.signalsRefusedWhileHeld: shadow-book signals refused because this lot held the single funded slot

unavailable.orderIds: no broker orders exist: this is a backtest of the pools engine
unavailable.commissions: the engine charges $0 commission; all friction is the per-side bps cost above
unavailable.intrabarFillDetail: the engine fills at minute-bar prices; there is no tick-level fill detail
unavailable.mfeWhenUnverified: a lot whose replay did not reproduce the engine MAE exactly has no MFE (mfeStatus says so)

lots.exitFrictionCharged: no (open lot: charged only when it exits)
